findings.detail: Identifier maturity parsing permutes or corrupts date components; for example Crimson is stored as 2/28/2033 while the source row states 2/18/2033.
The Safety revolver is paired to 2028-11-13 even though its source row states 12/19/2032, indicating cross-row or neighboring-issuer date association.

rationale: Class 2 review of the full named source rows decides the issue. The filing schedule states 2/18/2033 for Crimson, 5/12/2028 for Skopima, 8/9/2030 for VT Topco, and 10/1/2031 for all three YA facilities, matching the structured twin rather than the identifier dates. Safety's source revolver maturity is 12/19/2032, so its alleged 2028-11-13 twin is an unrelated row association. Hiller's source delayed-draw maturity is 6/20/2030, matching neither flagged value and independently confirming corrupted extraction. Thus the eight warnings expose real identifier/date extraction or row-association errors.
